answer: To prevent Sybil attacks in an agent economy monitoring coastal dune dynamics against the rising tide, the protocol mandates proof of burn. Each candidate agent must permanently destroy native tokens by sending them to an unspendable vault to mint an identity. An attacker incurs the verifiable cost of sacrificing liquid capital per forged persona. However, this irreversible expenditure creates high barriers to entry, pricing out honest underfunded or ephemeral agents.
